CustomField.description: Who sees this page. Both shows it to everyone, Internal Only to internal Salesforce users, and External Only to Experience Cloud and guest users. Lets one template serve different pages to staff and portal respondents. Cloning copies every page regardless. Defaults to Both.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Choose who sees this page: Both (everyone), Internal Only (logged-in Salesforce/staff users), or External Only (Experience Cloud/portal respondents). Use it to show or hide a page based on audience from a single template; leave it on Both unless a page is meant for only one group.
CustomField.label: Visibility
